messages.author: ff4a8f4fdb7301a0
messages.subject: Is shinnyaps partially down?
parts:
Hi,

I can access shinyapps.io normally and log in into my account. However, I can't load my own deployed shiny apps or https://nephantes.shinyapps.io/debrowser/. I know that in my case I'm getting near the limit of hours, but previously when that was the case the website would show a message about it. 

I'd be surprised of https://nephantes.shinyapps.io/debrowser/ was also running out of their hours since they just deployed their app 8 hours ago.

Best,
Leo
